scope: Audit the park-lamp path from machine-readable construction metadata through benchmark save, LOD binding and native-4K evidence preparation; remove contradictory aggregate metadata and make the existing lamp dependency fail-closed at the top-level gates.

preflight.action: No runtime evidence existed, so source/data QA hardening was permitted.

audit.initialObservation: QualityBlockParkFurnitureSaveGate and QualityBlockNative4KReviewPacket did not directly name QualityBlockParkLampInstallationQA, while a detailed lamp contract and validator existed.
audit.selfAuditCorrection: Inspection of QualityBlockParkFurnitureLodRebind showed that RebindAndValidate already owns QualityBlockParkLampInstallationQA.ApplyToOpenScene after PhysicalDiffuser creation and before explicit LOD renderer rebinding, and its completed-scene ValidateOpenScene already invokes QualityBlockParkLampInstallationQA.ValidateOpenScene. Therefore the lamp implementation was not actually orphaned from the save path. An initial direct ApplyToOpenScene added to the save gate in this run would have reconstructed the lamp twice; that duplication was removed rather than left in place.
audit.confirmedDefect: The aggregate park_street_furniture_contract.json still described the superseded stepped 190/150 mm pole and older chute/material states, while the authoritative dedicated contracts describe a continuous 190-to-125 mm taper, flush causal moisture submesh, curved service cover/head interfaces and fully metallic exposed stainless/steel after microdetail. That contradiction could undermine the required construction/material metadata critical gate even though the runtime implementation itself was already wired through LOD rebind.

changes.change: Added explicit lamp contract/lookdev requirements and final lamp validation; initially also added a direct reconstruction call before discovering that LOD rebind already owns that call.

Added explicit lamp contract configuration validation and direct installed-state validation pre-probe, immediately pre-Camera.Render and pre-temporal evidence. These are intentional top-level receipts even though lower-level LOD QA also validates the lamp.

Removed duplicate direct lamp reconstruction and documented QualityBlockParkFurnitureLodRebind as the single owner of the apply step; kept explicit contract/lookdev requirements and completed-state validation.

Raised aggregate contract to schema 1.3, added assembly-specific authority mapping, reconciled slide with the watertight U-section fabrication contract, reconciled the lamp with the continuous tapered installation contract, aligned exposed stainless/steel metallic intent with the authoritative microdetail pass, and refreshed required render evidence.

authoritativeLampOrder: LOD renderer arrays are rebuilt including PhysicalPole/service/head renderers
explicit native-packet lamp validation before reflection synchronization
explicit native-packet lamp validation immediately before Camera.Render
explicit native-packet lamp validation before temporal capture

sourceVerification.deduplicatedOwnership: Confirmed from QualityBlockParkFurnitureLodRebind source that it already applies the lamp and rebinds LOD renderers; save gate now does not duplicate that reconstruction.
sourceVerification.physicalDependency: QualityBlockParkFurniturePhysicalRefinement creates PhysicalDiffuser before LOD rebind; QualityBlockParkLampInstallationQA preserves PhysicalDiffuser while replacing the superseded pole/service/head parts.
sourceVerification.materialBinding: Final lamp validation remains after park microdetail, so exposed service fasteners are checked in their authoritative metallic state while concrete, paint, EPDM and diffuser remain dielectric.
sourceVerification.metadataConsistency: The aggregate contract now explicitly defers detailed assembly dimensions/interfaces to the dedicated contracts and no longer specifies the obsolete stepped lamp pole or partially metallic final exposed-metal intent.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstruction: No source-only points. Metadata and top-level receipts now describe/require the same continuous lamp assembly that LOD rebind already installs.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.materialPbr: No source-only points. Aggregate final-metal intent now matches the microdetail contract: exposed stainless/steel is fully metallic in the final prepared state while coating/concrete/EPDM/diffuser remain dielectric.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.weathering: No source-only points. The aggregate no longer describes a protruding moisture band and instead records the flush same-pole causal contact submesh.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLod: No source-only points. The authoritative apply step remains single-owned immediately before LOD rebind, and explicit native-packet receipts guard later evidence phases.
expectedVisualScoreImpact.criticalMetadataRisk: Reduced: conflicting machine-readable construction/material descriptions were reconciled rather than relying on undocumented precedence.
